text_block_list.text:
It's finally the weekend.
I head to the mall
to get some shopping
done and spot the
one and only Mihono Bourbon.

She's standing outside of an arcade, eyes
fixed on the neon
contraptions inside.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have observed that this arcade is
frequented by Umamusume with a
high
"sociability" parameter. However, I am
unsure whether to enter.

After pressing for more details, she tells
me that the arcade is popular among her
classmates, so she came to check it out as
a conversational
topic.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I have difficulty operating machinery
and am liable to destroy
electronic devices I
come in contact with. I assessed the
machines in the arcade and concluded that
risk management would be necessary

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
due
to their size.

For both Bourbon's sake and the
machines', I offer to show her
around.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I greatly appreciate your cooperation.

Waving my hand, I motion that it's no
problem. I decide that it would
be safer to
have me controlling the arcade machines
instead of her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Initiating "let's have fun"
protocol.
And so, our tour of the arcade begins.

text_block_list.name: Rock, Paper, Scissor...
text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors, shoot! Sorry, you
lost!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One win,
nine losses. A substantial drop in
your happiness has been detected. May I
offer some ice cream? Sweets are known
for their mood-boosting properties.

text_block_list.name: Slot Machine
text_block_list.text:
Drumroll please... Congratulations! You
win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A considerable amount of coins are
spilling
out of this machine. Is it
malfunctioning?

text_block_list.name: Punching Bag Machine
text_block_list.text:
16,000 points! You sent that monster
flying!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Punching power has been recorded as
16,000 points in my database.
Unit of
measurement unknown.

Despite her rather unorthodox reactions, I
can see Mihono Bourbon is
enjoying the
arcade.

It would be a waste to go home without
her playing at least one game, though.
After a few minutes of searching,
I point at a crane
game.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is this what you wish for me to play? Your
invitation is appreciated, but my
estimations show that I may permanently
put this device out of
service.

I ask her to watch from the side and
provide instructions. Content,
Mihono
Bourbon nods and positions herself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will calculate distances and
supply directions.

Sliding a coin into the slot, the machine
whirs to life. We begin
aiming for a bunny
perched on top of the toys.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please move twenty-two centimeters—yes,
stop right there. According
to my analysis,
we have a 98% chance of success.

Nodding, I press the button to grab the
prize. The plastic claw wraps
around the
toy's neck.
Flop.

The prize slips out and lands back
where it
started.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Lack of grip strength, noted. Adjusting
calculations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating a new course of action—pushing.
With this, we have an
estimated 91%
chance of—
Flop.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I have overestimated the arm's
maneuvering ability once again.

Reanalyzing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I predict a 75% chance of success—
Flop.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
... ...This contraption is proving to be a
fearsome foe.

I use up every trick I know,
but the stuffed
animal remains
unattainable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer. My failure in
ascertaining the arm's strength
led to such
disappointing results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...However, I believe there is a 70%
chance that we will procure the
prize on
our next turn. I suggest a final attempt.
The sudden proposal contradicts her usual passive attitude. She must be REALLY determined to win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will try my absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please stop there. Now move forward by
fourteen centimeters. We will push the toy
to the very edge and allow it to fall
naturally into
the prize box.

Biting my lip, I press the button to grab
the bunny. It falls, balancing
precariously
on the edge of the hole.

I hold my breath as if any movement would
throw the stuffed animal back toward its
friends. Glancing to my side, I notice
Mihono Bourbon
doing the same.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Come on!

After losing its battle with gravity, the
bunny slides gracefully into the
prize box.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support. I am now
equipped to handle conversations about
arcades. What's most interesting, however,
is that
I experienced new sensations today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
During our attempts at the claw game, I
observed new physical responses. A
ticklish feeling occurred inside my chest,
along with involuntary movements of my
facial muscles. I have added these new

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: responses to my "small talk" parameters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is this what you define "fun" as?

Mihono Bourbon slowly lets the word fall
out of her mouth, as if
uncertain about its
pronunciation. I gently explain what those
feelings mean.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It seems illogical to experience "fun"
while doing something unproductive such as
capturing stuffed animals with implausibly
weak
mechanical arms.

Carefully choosing my words, I express the
value of doing so-called
"unproductive"
things from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. All of this information is quite
novel to me. It seems that I
have entered a
state of "shock" now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will input this new information in as
well.
Perhaps seemingly
meaningless events are
not so meaningless after all.

Gently petting the bunny we got together,
Mihono Bourbon ponders
over her newly
gleaned perspectives.
